title: Joint venture of OKX and NYSE parent ICE files for 24/7 tokenized U.S. stock trading
reason: SEC filing by a major exchange-NYSE-parent joint venture for tokenized US stock trading is a significant regulatory and market-structure development, corroborated by three sources.

sources.summary: OKXICE, the joint venture of OKX and ICE, plans to launch tokenized U.S. stocks under SEC's new innovation exemption.
The stock trading platform seeks to offer tokenized shares in more than 60 US-listed companies under the SEC’s recently introduced innovation exemption.
OKXICE has notified the SEC that it intends to launch a tokenized securities trading venue under the innovation exemption.

title: Kraken operator Payward and Singapore Gulf Bank partner for 24/7 institutional crypto settlement
reason: Named-partner infrastructure launch for 24/7 institutional settlement, corroborated by two sources, clearly publishable.

sources.summary: The two firms will initially roll out the digital assets settlement service to select institutional clients in Asia and the Gulf region with around-the-clock U.S. dollar settlement.
The partnership will enable select institutions in Asia and the Gulf region to instantly settle US dollar transactions through the bank’s SGB Net
